text:
nimya: quick note from the CP peering follow-up: propose we standardize failure predicates for when to failover to Private endpoints vs keep retrying peering. wanted to float a simple decision table.
carla: important to standardize so ops runbooks are consistent.
ash: draft predicates:
- TCP-level: if 5 consecutive connect timeouts within 20s -> failover
- Reset/syn-rst: if >3 resets in 10s -> failover
- L7: if health endpoint returns 5xx for >2 checks spaced 5s -> failover
- Packet loss estimate >10% over 15s -> failover (requires edge telemetry)
toby: add a 'grace' window: on failover we debounce retries for 60s to avoid flip-flop.
nimya: agree. also add rate cap: no more than 2 failovers/min per-tenant to avoid alert storms.
infra-bot: created INFRA-7801: standardize failover predicates + debounce windows.
carla: approved. implement as configurable feature flags per-tenant.
nimya: thanks, PR incoming.
